run_benchmark_proxy_vs_provider: run the benchmark script to compare LiteLLM proxy latency and throughput against a direct provider endpoint
run_benchmark_with_concurrency_limit: run the benchmark with a max concurrent request limit to simulate realistic load testing conditions
run_benchmark_multiple_runs: run the benchmark multiple times and aggregate results for statistically accurate latency and throughput metrics
run_benchmark_parallel_mode: run the proxy and provider benchmarks simultaneously in parallel mode for faster execution
run_benchmark_quick_test: run a quick benchmark test with fewer requests to get fast performance comparison results
